name: Gal Kaplun
method: Built-in browser (Claude desktop app), 2026-10-30: read-only visit to the public Kaggle profile page and the public Competitions page, five seconds apart, one visit each, no refreshes. Page text was read after a six second wait, a screenshot of each page was inspected, and the join tooltip and the profile picture address were read from the page. The profile picture was downloaded once with curl and compared by eye with the saved portrait. An older draft written while Kaggle was blocking us was discarded; nothing here is carried from it except the portrait file, which was re-checked against the live page.

profile.bioText: No bio yet... Quietly working away
profile.note: The profile header and About page show no competition tier badge and no medal section, so no tier and no medal count is recorded. The absence of a tier badge is not read as a stated tier.

visibleCompetitionList.scopeNote: The Competitions page shows only the active ARC-AGI-3 entry and no Completed Competitions section. This is what is publicly displayed, not proof of the account's whole history. Nothing is invented. The displayed entry does not show a team name; the NVARC3 team name below comes from the repo's public roster record.

portrait.note: The live Kaggle profile picture (the large circle on his own profile page) is an illustrated caricature of one man with tousled brown hair and a moustache, in a red top, with a market-stall background and a sign reading Caminito. The saved 320 pixel file shows the same picture, same face, same background and same sign. It is a single individual picture, not a group image and not a default avatar. No replacement file was made.

teamNotes: The only team on record is ARC-AGI-3 team NVARC3, from the repo's public roster record (first observed 2026-10-13, last observed 2026-10-29). No past teams or finishes are displayed on his public profile, and no team medal is credited to him.
